title: Vacancy test
lead: This is how the system will check a candidate for this need. The test covers key and important topics, and items are split by topic weight. It is attached to an invitation and never changes the candidate's category.
examplesLead: Difficulty is close to the required level. Every time a new instance, no answer here.
attachHint: The candidate will answer items on the need's topics. Only you will see the result
